verdicts.reason: A: the bottle sits right on top of the body copy, so 'case of' and 'sparkling' are covered and hard to read. The bottle is also too small and floats in mid-air, the CTA is stretched to almost the full canvas width, and the bottom third of the canvas is empty. B: nothing collides and it stacks well for a tall format with a large bottle. However, 'WEEKEND ONLY' has moved below the body copy when it should come before the headline, the left-aligned text block clashes with the centred bottle and CTA, and there is empty space at the top.
